content:
maria: Quick pulse - did a scan of the quarter's postmortems, seeing 3 repeat failure modes: autoscaler oscillation, DB failover cleanup, and cron batch spikes. Can we lock owners here?
aj: I'll export incidents and post a compact table in ~24h.
sylvie: From eng: cron spikes cluster around 02:00 UTC for payments and analytics jobs. Several evictions.
devops-jen: Infra note: autoscaler defaults plus low min-replicas caused scale-down thrash; we need a cooldown policy.
kevin: DB note: a few failovers left read-only flags; pooled clients retried and exhausted connections.
maria: Proposed remediations: 1) Autoscaler safe defaults + cooldown; 2) Stagger/shard heavy cron jobs; 3) Runbook + automated cleanup job for DB failover.
aj: Uploaded CSV snapshot: https://redwood.s3/q4_incidents_trim.csv (filtered).
devops-jen: I'll own #1. Deliverable: PR with new defaults, canary rollout plan, telemetry. Target: 2025-11-10.
kevin: I'll own #3. Plan: runbook, cleanup job, and a failover integration test. Target: 2025-11-17.
sylvie: I'll own #2. Will coordinate with product and service owners to stagger windows; drafting RFC. Target: 2025-11-07.
oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly incident retro Thu 15:00 UTC https://meet.redwood/retro
aj: After issues are open I can run an attribution pass to estimate "prevented" incidents per remediation.
devops-jen: Short-term mitigation: spike enqueue rate-limiter when node mem >80% to dampen spikes. Low-risk, I'll PR this week.
nina: Ops request: include rollback + QA checklist in each PR.
maria: Plan: owners open GH issues by EOD tomorrow with targets and checklists. We'll review status at Thu retro. Thanks all :thumbsup:
